+def queue_identifier(item: PrioritizedIdentifier) -> None:
+    """Queue an identifier once, retaining any later import or priority request."""
+    with web.amazon_queue.mutex:
+        existing = next(
+            (queued for queued in web.amazon_queue.queue if queued == item), None
+        )
+        if existing is not None:
+            existing.stage_import |= item.stage_import
+            if item.priority < existing.priority:
+                existing.priority = item.priority
+                heapq.heapify(web.amazon_queue.queue)
+            return
+
+        heapq.heappush(web.amazon_queue.queue, item)
+        web.amazon_queue.unfinished_tasks += 1
+        web.amazon_queue.not_empty.notify()
+
